text:
ravi: Dropping a short design thread about a new compact "timeline strip" for SLO alert previews. Mock: https://img.redwood.test/ui/timeline-strip.png. Main choices: 1) show multiple overlapping suppressions as merged summary pill (e.g., 'Suppressed B7 schedule + manual') or show separate stacked pills; 2) timeline strip (left-to-right) that shows routing priority vs vertical stacked lanes. Also curious about copy tone: 'Muted' vs 'Suppressed' vs 'Paused'. Thoughts?

carmen: I like merged pill for tiny previews (keeps density down) but show individual reasons in an expandable panel. Timeline strip is neat for showing which channel served at which time; use lanes when there are >2 channels.

suzanne: Accessibility points: merged pills must expose full details to screen readers. If we visually merge, include an offscreen list: "Suppressed by schedule; manually muted by Alice until 14:00". For the timeline strip, ensure nodes are at least 44px tappable and provide readable labels on hover/focus.

kevin: Microcopy: prefer 'Muted until 14:00' when a specific end time exists, 'Suppressed B7 schedule' for ongoing schedule-based blocks, and 'Paused' only for user-initiated paused alerts. For overlapping cases show priority: e.g., "Muted until 14:00 (manual) B7 schedule" in expanded state.

carmen: UX note: for merged pill show a tiny chevron that reveals each suppression as a list; when expanded the timeline strip should highlight the active suppression. Also make sure +N overflow logic matches the channel display (if we compact channels we should compact suppressions too).

ravi: Good. Decision draft: default to merged pill with chevron that expands to stacked details; timeline strip visible for editors and detailed previews (toggleable), stacked lanes for >2 channels. For copy default to 'Muted until <time>' when we have end times else 'Suppressed B7 schedule'. @suzanne can you add the a11y offscreen examples and required aria announcements? @kevin please add three microcopy variants in the doc.

suzanne: Will add offscreen SR text patterns (examples + `aria-live` guidance). Also: avoid arrows-only visuals for SRs, use text like 'to' in aria labels.

design-bot: Figma frame updated: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/timeline-strip-v1 and figma comment thread: https://www.figma.com/comments/111

ravi: Thanks all B7 sync tomorrow 9:30 to lock microcopy and a11y checklist.
